defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or exit iron ore major exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore price weakness ('roaches seeth') signals demand softness; margin compression ahead

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid property developers and gaming names with going-concern risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and energy cost exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising oil and import costs pressure AUD; rate expectations create volatility

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure from oil-driven inflation fears, property credit stress, and iron ore weakness. Gold/rare earths and energy names provide relative strength. Qantas strike vote and Star/Bathla governance issues add idiosyncratic risk. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a narrow, volatile range.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA holds or eases, property stabilises, and critical minerals/gold cycle sustains. Renewable energy and critical minerals policy support offers structural tailwinds. Key risk is prolonged Middle East conflict elevating import costs and delaying rate cuts.
